title: Thiazoles in glycosylation reactions: Novel synthesis of thiazole thioglycosides
abstract: Abstract                                        This research reports a novel method for synthesizing new thiazole thioglycosides. This series of thiazole thioglycosides were designed by the reaction of potassium cyanocarbonimidodithioate                     2                     with benzoyl acetonitrile                     3a                     and ethyl bromoacetate                     3b                     in the presence of ethanol‐                     KOH                     to give the corresponding potassium 4‐amino‐5‐substituted‐thiazole‐2‐thiolates                     4a,b                     . The latter compounds were treated with peracetylated sugar bromides                     6a,b                     in                     DMF                     to give high yields of the corresponding thiazole thioglycosides                     7a‐d                     . Treatment of thiazole salts                     4a,b                     with hydrochloric acid gave the corresponding 3‐mercaptothiazole derivatives                     5a,b                     . The latter compounds were reacted with peracetylated sugars                     6                     in sodium hydride in                     DMF                     to produce the                     S                     ‐glycosyl compounds                     7a‐d                     . Ammonolysis of the protected thiazole thioglycosides                     6a‐h                     gave the corresponding free thiazole thioglycosides                     8a‐d                     . The compounds have been characterized by                     13                     C                     NMR                     ,                     1                     H                     NMR                     , and                     IR                     .
